note: User-curated calibration universe (valuation-recalibration-spec §3.1: the UNIVERSE is part of the pre-stated target). The human OWNS this list. The /calibration page SUGGESTS additions (researched cases + 13F-discovered candidates) but never auto-derives it. Edit this file (or, later, a curation UI) to add/remove names; the file's `version` is bumped on every change and a calibration_run records WHICH version it used for reproducibility. Intl/local_manual names need an operator-entered config/fundamentals/{TICKER}.json (the audited annual report) before they resolve; until then a run flags them `unresolved` in the coverage report — honest, never fabricated. Intl tickers are plausible local-listing placeholders for the GCC names (DFM/ADX), not guaranteed exchange symbols; the fundamentals_hint drives the tiered resolver, not the symbol.
